propositions: MCP transition_ticket and claim_ticket do not expose write parameters (force, reason, caused_by, ref) already supported by the library and CLI.
FastMCP derives input schemas from handwritten callable signatures; undeclared parameters are discarded before the adapter runs, making them unreachable over MCP.
The adapter forwarding layer only delegates close_class and assignee, so schema changes alone would not propagate undeclared parameters to the library core.
The 2026-08-18 operator ruling rescinds the force-only policy and establishes parity across all three surfaces (library, CLI, MCP) with absent certification as the audit signal.
Runtime probes confirmed the mechanism: live schemas omitted all fields, real registered-tool captures saw only current parameters, and MCP ref selected HEAD instead of requested commits.
